summary: Completed testing of per-number ticket limit feature. All 11 backend tests passed. Frontend correctly displays 'Límite por número' field in lottery cards showing 'Sin límite' or 'X boletos'. Backend APIs working: POST /tickets blocks when limit reached with descriptive error, GET /number-stats returns correct statistics, PUT /lotteries/{id} updates limit correctly.

issues: Ticket limit field shows 'boletos' plural even for 1 boleto - should be '1 boleto' singular

POST /api/tickets returns descriptive error message: 'Límite alcanzado: El número X ya tiene Y boletos vendidos (máximo: Z)'
POST /api/tickets/multi also validates ticket limits for multi-play tickets
GET /api/lotteries/{id}/number-stats correctly returns blocked_numbers array and individual number stats
Cancelled tickets correctly excluded from limit count (status != CANCELLED check)
Frontend displays ticket limit in lottery cards with 'Sin límite' or 'X boletos' format
Create lottery modal has 'Límite de Ventas' section with ticket limit field
seed_data_creation: Created multiple TEST_ prefixed lotteries with various ticket limits (1, 2, 3, 5). Existing lottery 'Quiniela 24H Limite Test' (5be25beb-5b88-40c9-82de-8a60fe768e1a) has limit=3.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Per-number ticket limit feature fully tested. Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_ticket_limit_per_number.py. All core features working: create lottery with limit, sell until limit, block when reached, number-stats endpoint, multi-play limit validation, update limit via PUT. Frontend displays limits correctly after hot reload.

POST /api/lotteries with ticket_limit_pe.notes: Creates lottery with limit correctly saved

GET /api/lotteries/{id} returns ticket_l.notes: Field correctly returned in lottery details

POST /api/tickets within limit.notes: Allows selling tickets up to limit

POST /api/tickets when limit reached.notes: Returns 400 with descriptive error message including number and counts

Other numbers available after one blocke.notes: Only blocks the specific number at limit

GET /api/lotteries/{id}/number-stats.notes: Returns sold_count, remaining, is_blocked, blocked_numbers array

PUT /api/lotteries/{id} to update limit.notes: Updates limit and allows more sales for previously blocked numbers

POST /api/tickets/multi validates limits.notes: Multi-play tickets also respect per-number limits

Cancelled tickets excluded from count.notes: Only non-cancelled tickets count towards limit

Frontend 'Límite por número' display.notes: Shows 'Sin límite' or 'X boletos' in lottery cards
